observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a used automotive engine block with valve cover, pulleys, belts, and wiring, sitting on a wooden shelf/workbench in what looks like a parts yard or warehouse.
A watermark reading 'UDEMEX LIMITED' and 'POSTED ON IJI' is overlaid on both images; this is the seller's own branding, not a product label.
No engine code, VIN, or manufacturer nameplate is legible in either photo.
Surfaces show dust, grime, and some surface rust on bolts and pulleys; no fluids, no electrical harness connectors tested.
Background shows other engine blocks and parts stacked nearby, consistent with a used/tokunbo parts dealer environment.
No photo shows the engine running, no compression test, no oil/coolant check, no odometer or vehicle tag linking the engine to a specific make/model/year.

identity.kind: used car engine (Japan import / tokunbo, make and model not visible)

claims.claim: Udemex investment deals of all kinds of japan parts
claims.evidence: No documentation, import papers, or country-of-origin marks visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Implied that this is a complete, working engine for sale
claims.evidence: No start-up video, no compression test, no fluid check shown in photo 0 or photo 1.

risks.risk: Engine make/model/displacement cannot be confirmed, which drives most of the price
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code stamp, ECU sticker, or a VIN/parts tag showing make and model
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this, since price range across makes/models is too wide

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (compression, timing, bearings)
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking/running, or a compression test reading

risks.risk: Missing accessories or sensors (turbo, injectors, sensors not visible/complete)
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photo set including intake, exhaust manifold, and wiring harness ends
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, with deductions for likely missing parts

risks.risk: Surface rust/corrosion suggests possible water exposure or long outdoor storage, raising risk of internal rust
risks.proof: Photo of oil dipstick/oil color and internal cylinder bore if accessible
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown internal corrosion risk, worst case

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/stamp or any manufacturer plate showing make, model, and displacement
A video of the engine being started or turned over
Photos of the engine from all sides including intake manifold, exhaust side, and wiring harness connectors
Photo of oil on the dipstick and any fluid leaks
response.reason: The engine's make, model, and running condition cannot be read from the photos, and these are exactly the details that set its price; without a legible engine code or a running test, even a worst-case price cannot be anchored to a real comparable.
